high_level_description: This image captures a beach scene on an overcast day, with a muted and somewhat somber atmosphere due to the gray sky. The waves are moderate, crashing onto the sandy shore, creating white foam as they meet the sand. A person is standing near the water's edge, facing away from the camera, seemingly observing the waves or the horizon. In the background, there is a row of modern high-rise buildings, likely hotels or residential apartments, indicating that this beach is located near a developed area. The buildings are white and have a contemporary architectural style.
